description: Narrow, registered ESLint suppressions for approved Zlog lifecycle/ref patterns. Never disable protected React hook/compiler rules without an ESLINT-* id that matches this registry. Not a licence to skip Android QA.

exceptions.reason: signedOut=1 must reset React login UI state after Sign out without wiping the password manager.
exceptions.preserves: AUTH-001 / AUTH-002 / AUTH-004 — app-held form state clear is conditional on ?signedOut=1 only

exceptions.reason: Switching editingReportId must clear save/share locks so Save is never silently blocked.
exceptions.preserves: Diary Save & Share stale-lock reset on report identity change

exceptions.reason: Opening/changing a saved diary must reset pdfCacheState before hydrate so a previous PDF cannot display.
exceptions.preserves: Saved-diary share PDF reuse / Android gesture-safe hydrate (DIARY-034)

exceptions.reason: Intentional client mount/hydrate fetch of company_brandings. load() already owns the async setState; the effect only invokes it. Runtime refactor would change branding first-paint without a product request.
exceptions.preserves: Branding settings list hydrate after sign-in

exceptions.reason: draftPhotosRef must track the latest draft list synchronously for late shadow/Save Area results. An effect would lag one frame.
exceptions.preserves: Location Walk Save Area persistence / draft photo identity

exceptions.reason: Viewer index must clamp when startIndex/maxIndex props change so the correct photo is shown.
Current Area is stored in sessionStorage and can only hydrate after mount (not during SSR render).
exceptions.preserves: Sticky Current Area across Location Walk photos

exceptions.reason: Preview index must clamp when startIndex/maxIndex change.
exceptions.preserves: PHOTO-001 / Phase D saved-photo review viewer index

exceptions.reason: Caption draft resets only when photo identity changes. Must not depend on acceptedDescription (typing-clobber).
exceptions.preserves: Phase D caption draft keyed by photo id

exceptions.reason: Resolve cached report preview immediately, else sign canonical report path. Never use the 512px thumbnail.
exceptions.preserves: PHOTO-001 / Phase D full viewer source (not thumbnail)

exceptions.reason: User photographs must use with contain. next/image can crop and violates PHOTO-001.
exceptions.preserves: PHOTO-001 — no crop, original aspect ratio

exceptions.reason: Company logos must keep original aspect; next/image is not approved for these previews.
exceptions.preserves: Report branding logo preview without crop

exceptions.reason: Setup hydrate loads once per edit target; createClient() is not referentially stable.
exceptions.preserves: Project & Report Details hydrate / SDSC fast path

exceptions.reason: Default branding auto-select effect must not re-run when createClient identity changes.
Re-hydrate programme dates when project row finishes loading or route id changes so the previous project's dates cannot stick.
exceptions.preserves: Project start / planned completion persistence on setup
